verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only `/login` with provider accounts or subscriptions (e.g., Claude Max, Kimi For Coding) and multi-account fallback. Nothing covers authenticating through an enterprise identity provider (SSO/SAML/OIDC) or a cloud platform such as Bedrock or Vertex. Provider subscription login is an adjacent feature, not the requested enterprise or cloud auth capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
